title: Wso2am: pre-authentication attacker could leverage type nesting to cause a StackOverflowError potentially leading to…
description: A security vulnerability in the wso2am package allows a pre-authentication attacker to exploit type nesting to trigger a StackOverflowError, which can cause a denial of service. The flaw affects versions prior to 4.4.0-r1 and 4.5.0-r4. A fix is available in these versions.
